set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 3. Choose temporal DCT or Haar, define typed logical tensor slots and a pure inspectable applicative-first DecodePlan, and execute it through an in-memory logical-payload interpreter from output-domain selections. Decide custom typed AST versus FreeApplicative from compile, allocation, ergonomics, batching, Scala.js, and data-dependent-read evidence. Acceptance: selection, partition, ordering, shape, and domain laws pass; the plan is inspectable before execution; coefficient and basis results cannot be exchanged; independent reads are collectable; no casts, Any, or string-associated result batches exist.
set.title: RRA 3: prove one typed applicative decode plan in memory
